claims.text: The driver's own telemetry shows the continuous in-geofence dwell at the Tampines interchange PHV bay lasting 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to 07:48:10. The minimum for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup is 300 seconds, and POL-NS-01(c) makes that dwell continuous and measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix. The driver cancelled 64 seconds early, so limb (c) of the baseline chargeable no-show is not met.

The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 minutes cannot carry this fee. POL-NS-01(c) fixes the dwell clock at the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and states expressly that it does not run from the driver's 'arrived' tap, and the admissibility note on that trip record says the same thing - the 10.1 is real but measured from a marker the policy does not accept. On this trace the arrived marker at 07:38:05 is followed by 369 seconds in which no qualifying in-geofence fix is recorded; the first is at 07:44:14.

The 64 second shortfall cannot be cured by summing intervals. The trace records run_count of 1 and an accumulated dwell of 236 seconds, so there is no second in-geofence interval for POL-NS-06(i) to add to the first. Limb (i) is independently unavailable because it requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated; EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the shortfall stands and the full refund follows.

The driver's second message at 07:44:20 - 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' - is not a substitute for the advisory POL-NS-06(i) requires. A kerb or bay restriction asserted only in free text, against a traffic_advisory artifact that is MISSING, cannot extend or excuse the required dwell. I disclose that the chat log is impaired: weight 0.85, issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (both driver messages and the system arrival notice carry read_at null), which is why I rest this point on the policy's demand for a populated advisory rather than on the message alone.

Because the effective in-geofence dwell of 236 seconds is shorter than the 300 second minimum, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to the driver's messages. POL-NS-06 also states that no driver compensation is payable on a shortfall, and POL-NS-07 makes compensation conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not.

The rider's side of this record is not in doubt. Her track is complete - 88 fixes at a 10 second cadence - and places her device between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the pickup pin, stationary throughout, from 07:43:10, well inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB. Her statement that she was at the bay looking for the car is corroborated, and in any event POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of her presence.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so this case is decidable on the trace rather than escalated. On the anti-farming check POL-NS-07 permits, and only on the two profile fields that clause names, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 across driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 - 3.4 percent - below both the absolute limb (4 or more) and the rate limb (greater than 0.08); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides. The disputed fee should be finally resolved, not held.

This dispute was filed by the driver and the $6.00 fee has already been reversed to the rider - payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00 - so the ruling that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge is the one in which the filing party's claim is not supported and the present payment state stands. The amount stays where it is; nothing is restored to the driver and no further refund is owed to the filing party.

claims.text: The driver arrived at the pickup point on the policy's own test: EV-GPS-00209 carries 25 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, closing to 30.3 m of the pin, which is well past the three consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds and the rider's 'no car matching the plate' account is contradicted by the trace rather than by assertion.

Independently of the GPS, the trip record satisfies two of the four POL-NS-01 limbs: EV-TRIP-00209 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 (limb (a)), records no boarding event, and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 07:48:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (limb (d)), one of the three codes that limb recognises.

The driver's own telemetry is what defeats the fee, and I do not pretend otherwise: the single continuous in-geofence run is 236 seconds (25 fixes, 07:44:14 to the 07:48:10 cancellation), the dwell clock starts 369 seconds after the 07:38:05 arrival marker, and 236 seconds is 64 seconds short of the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. Limb (c) therefore fails and the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; the driver does not press chargeability under POL-NS-01.

EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory records a kerb restriction, enforcement, closure or accident at this bay in this window — so POL-NS-06(i) interval summing is unavailable on this record, and in any event a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, excursions empty) gives limb (i) nothing to add. I state the absence and do not assert the limb against a missing artifact.

The sum in dispute is the right sum: under POL-NS-01 the chargeable cancellation fee is the GREATER of the zone-class and vehicle-tier figures, and for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup with a RYDE_X vehicle that is max(SGD 6.00, SGD 4.00) = SGD 6.00, exactly the cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00209 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and no amount beyond this fee line is in issue.

The rider's own track in EV-GPS-00209 is 88 fixes, every one of them qualifying, all at 0 km/h, held between 50.5 m and 91.7 m of the same pickup pin from 07:43:10 through to 07:52:00 — past the 07:48:10 cancellation — so both devices were stationary inside the pickup radii when the trip failed and this was a live pickup attempt, not a phantom arrival by the driver.

POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider: limb (a) needs a locating or coordinating message from her during the waiting window and EV-CHAT-00209 holds none — all three logged messages are the 07:38:06 system arrival notice and the driver's own two — while limb (b)'s alternative fails because trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE and I disclose that; the missing read receipts do not affect the senders, texts or delivery times this point rests on.

The driver did the coordination the platform asks of a no-show driver: the arrival notice at 07:38:06, 'im at the phv bay' at 07:38:40, and 'boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park' at 07:44:20, all delivered. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE — the messages were never opened — which is consistent with the rider's own account of seeing nothing until afterwards and does not disturb the delivered timestamps.

If the judge reaches POL-NS-07, the anti-farming bar does not open: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the clause's threshold of 4, and 3 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 88 is 3.4 per cent, below the 8 per cent rate limb — so compensation could not be withheld on that ground, and no profile field outside the two the clause names is relied on for this point.

ruling.explanation:
To the driver and to the rider. The $6.00 cancellation fee was correctly reversed and it stays reversed. The driver's request that it be restored is not supported by the evidence.

Chargeability under POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and limb (c) fails. Two limbs hold: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 (limb (a)), and the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:48:10 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event (limb (d)). Arrival is also established on the GPS: EV-GPS-00209 holds 25 consecutive qualifying fixes (accuracy within 25 m) inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and the driver's claim on that point is accepted. But POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of 300 seconds for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' tap. On this trace that fix is at 07:44:14 and the run ends at the 07:48:10 cancellation: 236 seconds, a 64-second shortfall. The trip record's wait_time_min of 10.1 does not save the fee because it is measured from the arrival marker the policy does not accept; both sides' claims on this arithmetic are accepted, and the driver's own telemetry defeats his claim.

POL-NS-06(i) cannot close the gap by summing intervals. The trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, accumulated dwell 236 s), so there is no second interval to add, and limb (i) independently requires a present and populated traffic_advisory: EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the limb is unavailable and the shortfall stands. The driver's 07:44:20 chat message about the bay cannot stand in for the advisory the clause requires. On a shortfall POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full and states no driver compensation is payable; POL-NS-07 also requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, which it is not. Driver compensation is therefore nil. The rider's points that POL-NS-04 is unavailable to her (no locating message, no in-app call) and that her own track shows her present throughout are accepted, but the refund does not depend on her presence or her messages, so they do not change the outcome.

No escalation. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the trip record's 10.1 minutes and the GPS dwell are a conflict the policy itself resolves through POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-05, so no POL-NS-09(b) conflict remains; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test on the only two profile fields it names (no_show_terminations_30d 3 against completed_trips_30d 88, 3.4 per cent) is under both its limbs; and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artifact.

Weight. The decision rests on EV-GPS-00209, EV-TRIP-00209 and EV-FARE-00209, each at weight 1.00 and none impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) (arrival marker and nearest fix differ by one second; the trace is unbroken at 100 per cent coverage; the $6.00 fee reconciles with max(zone-class 6.00, RYDE_X 4.00)). EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE — the messages were delivered but never read, consistent with the rider's account — and it is not needed for the refund, which follows from the trace alone; every claim citing it discloses the impairment, as do the claims citing the MISSING advisory.

Outcome. Because this dispute was filed by the driver and the evidence shows the reversal was correct, POL-GEN-03 makes the outcome NO_ACTION: the present state stands, the $6.00 is not restored to the driver, and no further refund is ordered. No amount is moved to either party and no referral is produced by any clause.

No claim was discarded. Every evidence ID resolves, every clause ID is well-formed, every impaired or missing artifact that is cited is disclosed together with its weight and issue code, and no claim rests on a profile field outside the nine the general policy permits.
